items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: Now I wasn't for singing too much until I used to sit down and listen to Lewis, Lewis Jordan, you know.

ctx.x: The singer in our band used to sing with Sam Cook.

Now I wasn't for singing too much until I used to sit down and listen to Lewis, Lewis Jordan, you know. Yeah. And he was the big fella out here then because he was, all these rhymes and little things that people are doing now on songs. He was doing them then, you know. Ain't nobody here but us chickens. And down by the head house and this, that, and the other way. I said, I'm gonna learn how to sing. So from behind his voice I started practicing songs. And besides just music alone. Mm-hmm. And then I used to, uh,…

Yeah. Do you ever know a guitar player around here? He's supposed to still be around here. His name is, uh, his name is Walter Nelson. Yeah, that's the one, that's Papoose. That's Papoose? He's dead. He's dead? Yeah. I know. Yeah, Dissa, uh, Sheik told me that, uh, that, uh, he didn't know if he was dead or not. He didn't know where he was or anything like that. Yeah, he did. And I was, uh, Walter Nelson Senior is still living.
